findings.issue: Text corruption in the pt explanation: the Japanese citation その仕事 was half-translated into Portuguese, appearing as 'seu仕事'. Besides garbling the quoted Japanese, 'seu' misrepresents その (= 'esse'), which could teach the learner a wrong equivalence. The en version correctly cites その仕事.
findings.current: O objeto seu仕事 leva を, e 簡単に é o advérbio formado a partir do adjetivo-な 簡単 ('fácil') + に ('facilmente').
findings.suggested: O objeto その仕事 leva を, e 簡単に é o advérbio formado a partir do adjetivo-な 簡単 ('fácil') + に ('facilmente').
